validity_engine.question: How strong is the evidence supporting a strategy claim under realistic conditions?
anti_p_hacking_rules: Metrics and comparison baselines must be defined before outcome evaluation for a frozen experiment version.
Observed outcomes may not be used to silently remove failing dimensions.
A failed or unstable dimension is reported as uncertainty; it is not repaired by changing the test after inspection.
Simple baselines must remain visible even when more complex models outperform them.
validity_engine.pass_fail_policy: Validity is not reduced to a single PASS unless a downstream safety or execution contract explicitly requires a binary gate. Research conclusions use evidence-strength semantics.

discipline_engine.question: Given the evidence and precommitted risk rules, is a contemplated action permitted?
discipline_engine.principle: The engine decides action eligibility and required discipline, not certain market direction.

behavioral_guards.anti_fomo: A contemplated chase may be blocked when price displacement, evidence deterioration, or risk-budget rules exceed predeclared limits.
behavioral_guards.anti_averaging_down: Additional buying after loss is not permitted merely because price is lower; ADD requires independent current eligibility and risk capacity.
behavioral_guards.stop_loss_lock: A hard stop may not be relaxed because of hope, sunk cost, or expected rebound. Any authorized modification must satisfy a predeclared adjustment condition.
behavioral_guards.take_profit_lock: Profit targets may not be raised solely because of greed; trailing or revised exits require predeclared objective conditions.
behavioral_guards.override_logging: Any human override is logged as an override and must not be retroactively relabeled as model-compliant.

implementation_order: Close the already-active V2.8.12R R1 technical gate without weakening or rewriting it.
Run an Integrity Exit Audit that inventories which existing integrity controls are constitution-level, compatibility-only, redundant, or unresolved.
Consolidate new governance decisions under V2.9_GOVERNANCE_KERNEL; do not migrate historical evidence destructively.
Implement a frozen Strategy Validity evaluator using predeclared metrics and baselines.
Implement Discipline Engine v1 as eligibility/risk-rule logic, not autonomous execution.
Only after the above, connect signals to action-eligibility outputs.
non_goals: No requirement that every external-source outage be solved inside model governance
No requirement to convert weak evidence into an action
